summary: Goat Butte lookout, a 1930 Region 5 cab on the Yakima Indian Reservation near Mount Adams, was abandoned by 1940 and is now ruins; access needs a Yakama Nation permit.

facts.status_note: Cab reduced to ruins; WillhiteWeb says a few ruins are said to remain.

access.note: WillhiteWeb lists a Yakama Nation Mt. Adams Recreation Area permit as required.

visit.trail_note: A 1946 USGS party took six hours to reach the site by horse, with the last water three miles before it. These are old figures; no current route is described.

notes_for_editor: Built 1930 (firetower, firelookout) agrees with WillhiteWeb's 1930s. Elevation 7,487 ft matches the brief's 2282 m. Spelling differs: Yakima on the registry and Weebly pages, Yakama Nation on WillhiteWeb; the brief's agency field keeps the registry wording. The 1940 abandonment rests on WillhiteWeb's second-hand account of a 1946 USGS party; not verified against the USGS report. Permit requirement comes from WillhiteWeb only; firetower gives no access detail beyond the reservation name. No staffing or fire records found. Fetched a WTA 'High Still Air' lookout feature PDF (wta.org); its cached text did not mention Goat Butte. Needs a second source for current site condition before any visit guidance is firmed up.
